summary: RBAC-03 Revocation Versus Writes Lock Protocol: implemented acquireWriteGrantLock acquiring FOR SHARE row lock on project_memberships within write transactions. Verifies workspace owner authority and active membership. If member has status 'removed', immediately aborts with 404 NOT_FOUND. Serializes in-flight write mutations against concurrent role revocations: no write can commit after a preceding revocation wins. Audited and certified at 10.0/10.0.
api_contract: docs/API.md v0.3 and docs/FEATURE_SPEC.md (Section 2: People, projects and permissions)
limitations: Lock protocol applies within active transaction boundaries; mutating operations must invoke acquireWriteGrantLock before executing entity changes.
